## Dispatch order · `domain:skills#2` · `session_01LqKsGyMNFwwnbF5FTAqyPn` · 2026-10-27T00:41Z

You are the os-dev developer agent for exactly ONE card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#26296, in your own card thread. Your role definition is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` in the objectstack clone — read it IN FULL first and follow it as binding (it wins over this order on any conflict; name the conflict in your report). Read the repo-root `AGENTS.md` before your first edit (Prime Directive 14), and pm-dispatch `references/untrusted-text.md`. Read the card's full body and every comment yourself (REST: `curl -sS -X GET "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/26296" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`), and the audit it comes from (#26184 comment 6425678185, Part A, § objectstack-i18n); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`). ⛔ Never use a GitHub MCP tool, read or write.

Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; it names your thread's branch in its `Branch:` line. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names the branch your thread was given (`claude/project-thread-…`); if no claim names it yet, send the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 one message with your branch name and wait for the claim. Worktree `objectstack-issue-26296` on that branch, based on a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"],"labels":["skip-changeset"]}]`, draft forced); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=26296 --file=F` (timestamps only as `{{NOW}}` / `{{WAS:…}}`). ⛔ No other GitHub write. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names).

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Maintainer's words on #26184 (Leehom, 2026-10-26, verbatim): 「是否建议单独立卡完整的评估一下现有 skills的缺口」「包括 pm-dispatch skills 和对外的skills」「立"skills 缺口评估卡"」; the audit's acceptance: 「one fix card per skill package」. Triage first grade for the eight audit cards is one anchor on #26184, comment 6425930271 (⛔ not a claim): this card is **p1** (`reports`, `positions`, `permissions` groups are 18.2 headline rows), `domain:skills`, Tier H (`skills/**` is a published surface). The rows below are the card's Measured section; teach exactly those, nothing wider: the card's 「Wanted」 is the whole scope.

### Scope and tier

File surface: `skills/objectstack-i18n/**` only — the files the card names plus the package's `evals/*.json` and, if the package carries one, `references/_index.md` (run `pnpm gen:skill-refs` if the index is generated; read `package.json` scripts). `skills/**` is a PUBLISHED surface on the governed register ⇒ the whole PR is **Tier H**: it stays a draft; the seat runs the independent `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review; the maintainer's hand (or an authorized APPROVED review by `os-zhuang` / `hotlong`) lands it. ⛔ You never ready, arm or enqueue it. `dispatch-gates --tier` for `skills/**`: MANDATORY ceiling tier with no one-line exit — that is why your thread runs at the tier it does.

`os-dev.md` 290–291 bind: the PR body reports TWO readings, the whole-file before/after line count of every changed `.md` file and the whole-package before/after (the sum over `SKILL.md` + `references/**/*.md` + `rules/**/*.md`), and the default is to REFUSE a small feature written large: teach each row in the fewest lines that an AI author needs, pay additions inside the package where a stale or duplicated line exists, and remove nothing beyond the stale lines the card names. Package reading at dispatch: package 533 lines (SKILL.md 503, references/_index.md 30); evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json 55 lines.

### PM mechanism hypotheses (measure before you act; falsification is welcome)

Read-only premise check on `origin/main` at dispatch (seat's subagent, 2026-10-27 00:36Z): **holds, with three corrections to the card's line references** — measure them yourself and write the corrected lines in the report's `deviations`:
1. `SKILL.md:169-172` (the top-level group list) omits `reports`, `positions`, `permissions`: 0 hits for `positions` / `permissions` in the package; the 3 `reports` hits (287, 397, 470) are prose, not the group. Spec: `reports.<name>.label` / `.description` at `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts:602-608, 1140-1143`; `positions` and `permissions` in the group list at `translation.zod.ts:724`.
2. **Correction A:** line 162 (`fields.{field_name}`) ALREADY lists `label`, `help`, `placeholder`, `options`; the spec key is `help` and `helpText` is only an alias (`translation.zod.ts:122`). So the card's 「`:165` adds `fields.FIELD` (`label`, `placeholder`, `helpText`)」 is wrong as written: the missing item is the `_sections.{name}.fields.FIELD` entry (line 165 is the `_sections` row), and the key to teach is `help` with `helpText` named as the alias — ⛔ do not add a duplicate object-level `fields` row.
3. **Correction B:** line 163 is `_views` and indeed lacks `title` — add it there.
4. The page tab item and approval step label paths: 0 hits for `approval` in the package; find the paths in `translation.zod.ts` and write one line each, or a pointer to the scaffold if it writes them (measure which).
5. Eval: 0 hits for `positions` / `permissions` in `bundles-locales-coverage.json` — the "translate a report and a permission set" eval is new.

### Card-specific clauses

- Every new teaching gets an eval prompt in the package's `evals/*.json` (`bundles-locales-coverage.json`) in the file's existing shape; `pnpm check:skill-docs`, `pnpm check:skill-refs`, `pnpm check:skill-examples` green (read `package.json` for the exact script names; if a name differs, run the one that exists and say so).
- PR body: line 1 `Fixes #26296`, then `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial (the skill teaches keys the protocol already carries), then the six-line `## 维护者速读` exactly as `os-dev.md` 285–289 require (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的; this is a Tier H PR, so 需要你做的 names the one action: approve, or 「Merge when ready」), then `## What changes`, `## Tests`, `## Acceptance notes`, `## Verification` with log readings folded into details/summary blocks. `skip-changeset` in `pr_create`'s `labels` (the skills packages carry no `package.json`; nothing is released). Name nothing beside `#26296` with a closing keyword; other card numbers appear only with zero verbs beside them.
- Gates: derive with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) on your final tree, run each locally (exit code captured before any pipe), reconcile with `--ran`; long gates detached under `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` with `OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT=issue-26296`. ⛔ Do not wait for CI after the PR opens.
- Serial: PR #25640 (version packages) touches line 1 of every `skills/*/SKILL.md` (frontmatter version); do not edit that line. No open PR touches `skills/objectstack-i18n/**` beyond #25640's version line.
- Commit trailers: the model-free pair exactly as `os-dev.md` / `AGENTS.md` spell them; ⛔ no model name anywhere in the commit or PR.
- Final report: the JSON exactly per `os-dev.md` (issue comment on #26296 whose first line is `os-dev-report`, then the same JSON as your hand-back message to the seat thread), with `deviations`, `line_budget` (per `.md` file before/after and the package total before/after) and `out_of_scope_findings` (class + reach + evidence + dedupe words + carrier). Hand back: one message to the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 with the PR number, head sha and the report's key points; keep your thread open through the review (a FAIL comes back to you).
